carmen_marketing: Quick flag 1: dozens of webinar leads this morning went into HubSpot but ended up in the overflow queue and never alerted SDRs. Saw bounce from our webhook delivery service.
eli_revops: rough number? timeframe?
carmen_marketing: ~24 leads between 05:40-06:10 UTC from APAC replay. HS shows owner blank and property `route_state=overflow`.
jasper_eng: checked logs: webhook retries were exhausted because the enrichment service returned repeated 503s. Our intake logic moves to overflow when enrichment retries >3 and then we stop RR assignment.
michelle_sdr: so no notification to reps at all? that's a lot of cold misses.
jasper_eng: yeah. current intent was to avoid misrouting bad payloads, but overflow should still trigger a temporary owner assignment so reps get a heads-up.
eli_revops: short-term: we need a fallback assignment from overflow to `sdr_triage_pool` after a short hold. propose 12s. also tag those leads with `overflow_fallback=true`.
carmen_marketing: agree. can we also backfill a quick note in HS so reps know enrichment is pending?
jasper_eng: will patch intake lambda: if route_state==overflow && now - inlet_time > 12000 then assign fallback and set hs_note. snippet I'm about to push to canary:
```
if (lead.route_state === 'overflow' && now - lead.inlet_time > 12000) {
  assignOwner('sdr_triage_pool', lead, 'overflow_fallback')
  hubspot.setProperty(lead.id, 'hs_note', 'Assigned due to overflow; enrichment pending')
}
```
leadflow_bot: Deploy queued: intake-lambda v1.12.4-canary -> 2 nodes.
jasper_eng: canary passed. tested 10 synthetic overflow leads, 9/10 assigned fallback at ~12s.
eli_revops: add analytics event `overflow_fallback_assign` with tags: region, campaign, source. set alert if fallback_rate > 4% in 1h.
michelle_sdr: i'll monitor Slack and flag any rep complaints; also put a note in the SDR playbook about `overflow_fallback=true` leads - light touch first.
carmen_marketing: I'll update HubSpot workflow to show `hs_note` and to set a temporary owner if empty. linking this thread in the workflow history.
jasper_eng: rolling to prod in 3 waves now. will watch fallback% and any duplicate notification risk.
leadflow_bot: Prod rollout started: intake-lambda v1.12.4 -> wave 1 (10%).
leadflow_bot: Wave 3 complete: fallback_assign_rate=2.7% (last 30m).
eli_revops: follow-ups: 1) run 48h conversion cohort on overflow_fallback vs normal assigned 2) add unit tests for overflow -> fallback transition 3) document overflow semantics in routing README. Retro tomorrow 10am PT.
carmen_marketing: thanks all. closing once cohort looks ok.
michelle_sdr: :thumbsup:
